snippet.description:
What actually changes the way you prepare for UPSC?

AIR 56 Samiksha Dwivedi shares 15 mindset shifts she learned through five attempts, including how to study for marks, use mock tests, plan backwards from the exam, improve answer writing and learn from mistakes.

If you’re preparing for Prelims or Mains, these lessons can help you rethink your strategy and make your preparation more focused, practical and consistent.
